rows.grounds: neuter accusative plural of sarvakarman, 'all acts'.
locative singular of dehānta, 'end of body'.

items.question: What result follows at the end of the body?
premises: At body's end one becomes Bhairava.
items.inference: Completion yields full ritual efficacy and final transformation into Bhairava.
uncertainties: Exact referent of all acts unspecified.
items.plain_english: One obtains all acts; at the end of the body one becomes Bhairava.
